scripts.code:
-- [[ CONFIGURATION ]]
local TOGGLE_KEY        = Enum.KeyCode.V
local PANIC_KEY         = Enum.KeyCode.End
local AUTO_OFF_MINUTES  = 10

-- [[ CORE SERVICES ]]
local Players          = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService  = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService       = game:GetService("RunService")
local CoreGui          = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local player    = Players.LocalPlayer
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 5)
local uniqueTag = "TrueRightClickUnlocker_v105"
local bindName  = "MouseUnlockerPriorityLoop_v105"

-- [[ 1. MEMORY & TELEPORT CLEANUP ]]
local function globalCleanup()
    pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
    for _, obj in pairs(CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
        if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
            pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
        end
    end
    if playerGui then
        for _, obj in pairs(playerGui:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:GetAttribute(uniqueTag) or obj.Name == "InternalMouseControlMax" then 
                pcall(function() obj:Destroy() end) 
            end
        end
    end
end
globalCleanup() 

-- [[ 2. UI CONTAINER ]]
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "InternalMouseControlMax"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
screenGui:SetAttribute(uniqueTag, true)

local parentSuccess = pcall(function() screenGui.Parent = CoreGui end)
if not parentSuccess and playerGui then screenGui.Parent = playerGui end

local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggleBtn.Name = "MaxOverride"
toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
toggleBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
toggleBtn.Text = ""
toggleBtn.Modal = false 
toggleBtn.Parent = screenGui

-- [[ 3. SMART CAMERA & SHIFT-LOCK PROFILER ]]
local function isFirstPerson()
    local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not cam then return false end
    
    if player.CameraMode == Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson then return true end
    
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return false end

    local trackingPart = char:FindFirstChild("Head") 
        or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") 
        or char.PrimaryPart
        
    if trackingPart then
        local distance = (cam.CFrame.Position - trackingPart.Position).Magnitude
        return distance <= 2.2
    end

    return false
end

-- [[ 4. PRIORITY RENDER LOOP ]]
local rightMouseDown = false
local startTime = os.time()

local function priorityFrameUpdate()
    if (os.time() - startTime) >= (AUTO_OFF_MINUTES * 60) then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal and not isFirstPerson() then
        toggleBtn.Modal = false
        pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
        UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        return
    end

    if toggleBtn.Modal then
        if rightMouseDown then
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        else
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
        end
    end
end

-- [[ 5. HARDENED EVENT LISTENERS ]]
local connections = {}

local function terminateSystem()
    toggleBtn.Modal = false
    globalCleanup()
    for _, conn in pairs(connections) do
        if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    table.clear(connections)
    UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
end

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
    if input.KeyCode == TOGGLE_KEY then
        if not isFirstPerson() then return end
        
        toggleBtn.Modal = not toggleBtn.Modal
        if toggleBtn.Modal then
            UserInputService.MouseIconEnabled = true
            startTime = os.time() 
            RunService:BindToRenderStep(bindName, Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, priorityFrameUpdate)
        else
            pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep(bindName) end)
            UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCenter
        end
    elseif input.KeyCode == PANIC_KEY then
        terminateSystem()
    end
    
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = true
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
        rightMouseDown = false
    end
end))

table.insert(connections, UserInputService.WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function()
    rightMouseDown = false
end))

if getgenv().DEAutoDelivery then return end
getgenv().DEAutoDelivery = true

local Plrs = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local CS = game:GetService('CollectionService')
local RS = game:GetService('ReplicatedStorage')

local plr = Plrs.LocalPlayer
local delivery = require(RS.Modules.Client.Jobs.Tasks.DeliveryJobTask)
local deliveryUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Jobs.Delivery.DeliveryUtil)
local vehicles = require(RS.Modules.Client.Vehicles.VehicleController)
local vehicleUtil = require(RS.Modules.Shared.Vehicles.VehicleUtil)
local tpGuard = require(RS.Modules.Client.Exploit.VehicleTeleportDetectionController)

if getconnections then
    pcall(function()
        for _, v in ipairs(getconnections(plr.Idled)) do
            v:Disable()
        end
    end)
end

local function getLoc(pos, skipLast)
    local loc, dist

    for _, v in ipairs(CS:GetTagged('DeliveryLocation')) do
        if v:IsA('BasePart') and v.Parent then
            if not skipLast or not deliveryUtil.IsLastDeliveryLocation(plr, v) then
                local d = (v.Position - pos).Magnitude
                if not dist or d < dist then loc, dist = v, d end
            end
        end
    end

    return loc
end

local hover

local function tp(cf)
    local char = plr.Character
    if not char then return end

    local car = vehicleUtil.getPlayerData(plr)
    local chassis = vehicles.getActiveChassisController()

    if car and car.Model and car.WeightPart then
        if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = true end

        tpGuard.AuthorizeNextTeleport()
        car.Model.PrimaryPart = car.WeightPart
        car.Model:SetPrimaryPartCFrame(cf)
        car.WeightPart.Anchored = false
        if hover then hover:Destroy() end

        hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
        hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
        hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
        hover.Parent = car.WeightPart

        for _, v in ipairs(car.Model:GetDescendants()) do
            if v:IsA('BasePart') then
                v.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                v.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
            end
        end

        task.defer(function()
            if chassis then chassis.Teleporting = false end
        end)
    else
        char:PivotTo(cf)

        local hrp = char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
        if hrp then
            if hover then hover:Destroy() end

            hover = Instance.new('BodyVelocity')
            hover.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
            hover.Velocity = Vector3.zero
            hover.Parent = hrp

            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
    local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')

    if hrp then hrp.Anchored = false end
    if hum and hover and hover.Parent == hrp then
        hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
    end
end)

local curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick, lastFire, dropAt

while task.wait(0.1) do
    local char = plr.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')

    if hrp then
        if plr:GetAttribute('JobId') ~= 'Delivery' then
            RS.Remotes.RequestStartJobSession:FireServer('Delivery', 'deliveryHub', 'HighRisk')
            curTarget, curLoc, curPhase, lastTick = nil, nil, nil, nil
            task.wait(0.5)
        else
            local state = delivery.GetCurrentDeliveryState()
            local target, phase

            if state then
                lastTick = nil

                local carried = state.ItemsCarried or 0
                local cap = state.MaxCapacity or carried
                local full = carried >= cap
                local noMore = state.PackagesRemainingAtPickup == 0

                if carried > 0 and (full or noMore) then
                    phase = 'drop'
                    dropAt = dropAt or tick() + 4.5

                    if tick() >= dropAt then
                        target = state.DestinationPosition
                    else
                        target = state.PickupPosition
                    end
                else
                    dropAt = nil
                    phase = 'pickup'
                    target = state.PickupPosition
                end
            else
                lastTick = lastTick or tick()

                if tick() - lastTick > 0.25 then
                    local loc = getLoc(hrp.Position, true) or getLoc(hrp.Position)
                    phase = 'new'
                    target = loc and loc.Position
                end
            end

            if target then
                if target ~= curTarget or phase ~= curPhase then
                    tp(CFrame.new(target + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)))
                    curTarget, curPhase = target, phase
                end

                local loc = getLoc(target)

                if loc then
                    if loc ~= curLoc then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationInteracted:FireServer(loc)
                        curLoc, lastFire = loc, tick()
                    elseif tick() - lastFire > 1 then
                        RS.Remotes.DeliveryLocationInteracted:FireServer(loc)
                        lastFire = tick()
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

	premium = false,
	ids = 0,
	pos = nil,
}

local orig = {}
local M = {}

local conns = {}
local btn

local function say(fmt, ...)
	local s = string.format(fmt, ...)
	print("[TTO-PREM] " .. s)
	return s
end

local function mod(name)
	local ps = Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	local root = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("TTOClient")
	if not root then return nil end
	local inst = root:FindFirstChild(name)
	if not inst then return nil end
	local ok, res = pcall(require, inst)
	if not ok then
		say("require %s failed: %s", name, tostring(res))
		return nil
	end
	return res
end

local function premiumIds()
	local ids = {}
	local Tools = M.Tools
	if Tools and Tools.LIST then
		for _, item in pairs(Tools.LIST) do
			if type(item) == "table" and item.premium and item.id then
				table.insert(ids, item.id)
			end
		end
	end
	return ids
end

local function realOwns(id)
	local P = M.Passes
	if not P then return false end
	if RunService:IsStudio() and P.studioUnlock then
		return true
	end
	local v1 = P.ALIAS[id] or id
	local cat = P.CAT[v1]
	if P.owned[v1] or P.packOwned.bundle or P.freeItems[v1] then
		return true
	end
	if not cat then
		return false
	end
	if P.trialOn then
		return true
	end
	if P.tryItem == v1 and os.clock() < (P.tryEnd or 0) then
		return true
	end
	if cat == "tools" or cat == "powers" then
		return P.packOwned[cat] == true
	end
	return false
end

local function realOwnsSkin(id, sub)
	local P = M.Passes
	return P.freeSkins[tostring(id) .. "/" .. tostring(sub)] == true
end

local function realIsVip()
	local P = M.Passes
	return P.packOwned.vip == true
end

local function realOwnsPack(pack)
	local P = M.Passes
	if pack == "vip" then
		return P.packOwned.vip == true
	end
	if P.packOwned[pack] == true then
		return true
	end
	return P.packOwned.bundle == true
end

local function truePackFlags()
	local flags = {}
	local mms = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
	local uid = Players.LocalPlayer and Players.LocalPlayer.UserId
	local ids = (M.Passes and M.Passes.PACK_IDS) or {}
	for name, id in pairs(ids) do
		if type(id) == "number" and id ~= 0 and uid then
			local ok, has = pcall(function()
				return mms:UserOwnsGamePassAsync(uid, id)
			end)
			if ok and has == true then
				flags[name] = true
			end
		end
	end
	return flags

	return 0

		say("Passes module missing")
		return false
	end

		if not orig.pack then
			orig.pack = {}
			for k, v in pairs(P.packOwned or {}) do

			end
			orig.trialOn = P.trialOn
			orig.studioUnlock = P.studioUnlock
		end

			return true
		end
		P.ownsSkin = function()
			return true
		end
		P.isVip = function()
			return true
		end
		P.ownsPack = function(_)
			return true
		end
		P.trialOn = true
		P.studioUnlock = true
		P.packOwned = P.packOwned or {}
		P.packOwned.bundle = true
		P.packOwned.tools = true
		P.packOwned.powers = true
		P.packOwned.vip = true
		P.owned = P.owned or {}

	local cy = math.clamp(center.Y, half.Y, math.max(half.Y, v.Y - half.Y))
	btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + ins.X, cy + ins.Y)
	state.pos = Vector2.new(cx, cy)
end

local function placeButton()
	if not btn then return end
	local v = viewport()
	local compact = v.X < 900 or v.Y < 620
	local w = compact and 104 or 118
	local h = compact and 26 or 30
	btn.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
	btn.TextSize = compact and 12 or 13
	if state.pos then
		moveTo(state.pos)
	else
		btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y)
	end
end

refreshButton = function()
	if not btn then return end
	btn.Text = state.premium and ("PREMIUM ON " .. state.ids) or "PREMIUM OFF"
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.premium and Color3.fromRGB(38, 120, 74) or Color3.fromRGB(74, 44, 48)
end

local function destroyButton()
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
		pcall(function()
			c:Disconnect()
		end)
	end
	table.clear(conns)
	if btn then
		pcall(function()
			btn:Destroy()
		end)
	end
	btn = nil
end

local function buildButton()
	destroyButton()

	local pg = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	for _, c in pg:GetChildren() do
		if c:IsA("ScreenGui") and c.Name == "TTOPremium" then
			pcall(function()
				c:Destroy()
			end)
		end
	end

	local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
	gui.Name = "TTOPremium"
	gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
	gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
	gui.DisplayOrder = 999
	gui.Parent = pg

	btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = "PremiumToggle"
	btn.Text = ""
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 244, 250)
	btn.BorderSizePixel = 0
	btn.AutoButtonColor = true
	btn.Parent = gui

	local corner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	corner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	corner.Parent = btn

	local stroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 98, 120)
	stroke.Thickness = 1
	stroke.Parent = btn

	local drag = {
		active = false,
		moved = false,
		startPos = Vector2.zero,
		startCenter = Vector2.zero,
	}

	local function isPointer(t)
		return t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or t == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
	end

	btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if not isPointer(input.UserInputType) then return end
		drag.active = true
		drag.moved = false
		drag.startPos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		drag.startCenter = btn.AbsolutePosition + btn.AbsoluteSize * 0.5
	end)

	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if not drag.active then return end
		local t = input.UserInputType
		if t ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and t ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local p = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local delta = p - drag.startPos
		if delta.Magnitude > 4 then
			drag.moved = true
		end
		if drag.moved then
			moveTo(drag.startCenter + delta)
		end
	end)

	conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
		if not isPointer(input.UserInputType) then return end
		drag.active = false
	end)

	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		if drag.moved then
			drag.moved = false
			return
		end
		setPremium(not state.premium)
	end)

	placeButton()
	refreshButton()
end

local function teardown()
	setPremium(false)
	destroyButton()
	state.premium = false
	rawset(ENV, "TTO", nil)
	say("torn down")
end

local function main()
	local prev = rawget(ENV, "TTO")
	if prev and type(prev.teardown) == "function" then
		pcall(prev.teardown)
	end

	M.Passes = mod("Passes")
	M.Tools = mod("Tools")
	M.Products = mod("Products")

	buildButton()
	setPremium(true)

	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if cam then
		cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
			placeButton()
		end)
	end

	ENV.TTO = {
		state = state,
		modules = M,
		premium = setPremium,
		toggle = function()
			return setPremium(not state.premium)
		end,
		move = moveTo,
		teardown = teardown,
	}
	say("ready")
end

            local root = getRoot()
            local hum = getHumanoid()
            if not root or not hum then return end

            local vertical = 0

            if flyDown then vertical = -1 end

            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity =

                + Vector3.new(0, vertical * flySpeed, 0)

    else

        if root then
            root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
        end
    end

scripts.title: Auto Farm Doors
scripts.author: morenoZzz
scripts.summary: Farm door
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local LP = Players.LocalPlayer
local ESP_ON = true
local AutoClick = true
local COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 170, 0)

local tracked = {} -- [model] = {hl, gui, label, door}
local hooked = {}  -- prompts que já têm auto clicar

local function isCandyDoor(m)
    local door = m:FindFirstChild("Door")
    return m:FindFirstChild("Frame") and door and door:FindFirstChild("OpenSound")
end

local function untrack(m)
    local t = tracked[m]
    if t then
        t.hl:Destroy()
        t.gui:Destroy()
        tracked[m] = nil
    end
end

local function track(m)
    if tracked[m] or not ESP_ON then return end
    local door = m:FindFirstChild("Door")
    if not (door and door:IsA("BasePart")) or door.Transparency >= 1 then return end

    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
    hl.Adornee = m
    hl.FillColor = COLOR
    hl.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    hl.FillTransparency = 0.4
    hl.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
    hl.Parent = m

    local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
    gui.Adornee = door
    gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(140, 24)
    gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
    gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
    gui.Parent = m

    local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.TextColor3 = COLOR
    label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0
    label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
    label.TextSize = 14
    label.Text = "Porta de doce"
    label.Parent = gui

    tracked[m] = {hl = hl, gui = gui, label = label, door = door}

    m.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
        if not parent then untrack(m) end
    end)
end

local function setup(v)
    if not v:IsA("ProximityPrompt") then return end

    -- auto clicar
    if not hooked[v] then
        hooked[v] = true
        v.HoldDuration = 0
        v.PromptShown:Connect(function()
            if AutoClick then
                fireproximityprompt(v)
            end
        end)
        v.AncestryChanged:Connect(function(_, parent)
            if not parent then hooked[v] = nil end
        end)
    end

    -- ESP se o prompt for de uma porta de doce
    local a = v.Parent
    while a and a ~= Workspace do
        if isCandyDoor(a) then
            track(a)
            break
        end
        a = a.Parent
    end
end

for _, v in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    setup(v)
end
Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(setup)

-- some o ESP quando a porta abre
pcall(function()
    RS.Remotes.HALLOWEEN_VFX.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(name, obj)
        if name == "OpenDoor" and typeof(obj) == "Instance" then
            untrack(obj)
        end
    end)
end)

-- atualiza distância e limpa portas que já sumiram
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
    local char = LP.Character
    local hrp = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    for m, t in pairs(tracked) do
        if t.door.Transparency >= 1 then
            untrack(m)
        elseif hrp then
            t.label.Text = ("Porta de doce [%d]"):format((t.door.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude)
        end
    end
end)

--[[

    !! WARNING !!

    This script will not work on XENO or SOLARA.
    Tested on Real executor. Probably works fine on any paid executor
    By xyznick                                               

]]

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

if getgenv().UnlockAllStop then
    pcall(getgenv().UnlockAllStop)
    getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = true
end
if getgenv().unlock_all_enabled == nil then getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = true end
local instance = {}
getgenv().UnlockAllInstance = instance
local function on() return getgenv().unlock_all_enabled == true and getgenv().UnlockAllInstance == instance end

local Registry = require(RS.Items.Registry)
local Inv = require(RS.Client.Services.UserData.Inventory)
local CharacterService = require(RS.Services.Asset.CharacterService)
local CharRegistry = require(RS.Objects.Game.Character.DataRegistry)
local Remotes = RS.Shared.UserData.Remotes
local EquipRemote, SwapRemote, SetSkinRemote = Remotes.Equip, Remotes.SwapSlots, Remotes.SetSkin
local TaskRemote = RS.Remotes.Character.CharacterTask
local origSetTerm
local fakeEmote = nil

local SAVE_FOLDER, SAVE_FILE = "UnlockAll", "UnlockAll/state.json"
local COSMETIC_SLOT = {Cosmetic = true, Unusual = true, Character = true, Emote = true, CarryAnimation = true, Nametag = true}

local cache, allCosmetics = {}, {}
local function isCosmetic(id)
    local c = cache[id]
    if c ~= nil then return c end
    local ok, cfg = pcall(Registry.GetConfig, id)
    local r = false
    if ok and type(cfg) == "table" then
        local st = cfg.EquipInfo and cfg.EquipInfo.SlotType
        r = (st ~= nil and COSMETIC_SLOT[st] == true) or cfg.CosmeticInfo ~= nil or cfg.EmoteInfo ~= nil
    end
    cache[id] = r
    return r
end
local function slotTypeOf(id)
    local ok, cfg = pcall(Registry.GetConfig, id)
    return ok and type(cfg) == "table" and cfg.EquipInfo and cfg.EquipInfo.SlotType or nil
end
for id = 1, Registry.GetCount() + 2000 do
    if isCosmetic(id) then allCosmetics[#allCosmetics + 1] = id end
end

local slotOverlay, skinOverlay = {}, {}
local slotObs, skinObs, loadoutObs = {}, {}, {}
local blocked = 0

local function save()
    pcall(function()
        if not isfolder(SAVE_FOLDER) then makefolder(SAVE_FOLDER) end
        local skins = {}
        for k, v in pairs(skinOverlay) do skins[tostring(k)] = v end
        writefile(SAVE_FILE, HttpService:JSONEncode({slots = slotOverlay, skins = skins}))
    end)
end
pcall(function()
    if isfile(SAVE_FILE) then
        local d = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(SAVE_FILE))
        for k, v in pairs(d.slots or {}) do slotOverlay[k] = v end
        for k, v in pairs(d.skins or {}) do skinOverlay[tonumber(k)] = v end
    end
end)

local orig = {}
local function hook(name, fn)
    orig[name] = hookfunction(Inv[name], fn)
end

local function effective(slot)
    local o = slotOverlay[slot]
    if o == nil then return orig.GetEquipped(slot) end
    if o == false then return nil end
    return o
end
local function effectiveSkin(base)
    local o = skinOverlay[base]
    if o == nil then return orig.GetSkin(base) end
    if o == false then return nil end
    return o
end
local refreshLocal
local function fireAll()
    for _, o in ipairs(slotObs) do pcall(o.push) end
    for _, o in ipairs(skinObs) do pcall(o.push) end
    for _, cb in ipairs(loadoutObs) do pcall(cb) end
    if refreshLocal then pcall(refreshLocal) end
end

hook("Owns", function(id)
    if on() and isCosmetic(id) then return true end
    return orig.Owns(id)
end)
hook("IsUnlocked", function(id)
    if on() and isCosmetic(id) then return true end
    return orig.IsUnlocked(id)
end)
hook("OwnedIds", function()
    local list = orig.OwnedIds()
    if not on() then return list end
    local have = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(list) do have[id] = true end
    for _, id in ipairs(allCosmetics) do if not have[id] then list[#list + 1] = id end end
    table.sort(list)
    return list
end)
hook("GetOwnedBySlotType", function(slotType)
    local list = orig.GetOwnedBySlotType(slotType)
    if not on() or not COSMETIC_SLOT[slotType] then return list end
    local have = {}
    for _, id in ipairs(list) do have[id] = true end
    for _, id in ipairs(allCosmetics) do
        if not have[id] and slotTypeOf(id) == slotType then list[#list + 1] = id end
    end
    return list
end)
hook("IsSlotAvailable", function(slot)
    if on() and COSMETIC_SLOT[Inv.GetSlotType(slot)] then return true end
    return orig.IsSlotAvailable(slot)
end)
hook("GetEquipped", function(slot)
    if not on() then return orig.GetEquipped(slot) end
    return effective(slot)
end)
hook("GetLoadout", function()
    local r = orig.GetLoadout()
    if not on() then return r end
    for slot, v in pairs(slotOverlay) do r[slot] = v or nil end
    return r
end)
hook("IsEquipped", function(id)
    if not on() then return orig.IsEquipped(id) end
    for slot in pairs(Inv.GetSlots()) do
        if effective(slot) == id then return true, slot end
    end
    return false, nil
end)
hook("ObserveSlot", function(slot, cb)
    local entry = {push = function() cb(on() and effective(slot) or orig.GetEquipped(slot)) end}
    local disc = orig.ObserveSlot(slot, function() entry.push() end)
    slotObs[#slotObs + 1] = entry
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(slotObs, entry)
        if i then table.remove(slotObs, i) end
    end
end)
hook("ObserveLoadout", function(cb)
    local disc = orig.ObserveLoadout(cb)
    loadoutObs[#loadoutObs + 1] = cb
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(loadoutObs, cb)
        if i then table.remove(loadoutObs, i) end
    end
end)
hook("GetSkin", function(base)
    if not on() then return orig.GetSkin(base) end
    return effectiveSkin(base)
end)
hook("ObserveSkin", function(base, cb)
    local entry = {push = function() cb(on() and effectiveSkin(base) or orig.GetSkin(base)) end}
    local disc = orig.ObserveSkin(base, function() entry.push() end)
    skinObs[#skinObs + 1] = entry
    return function()
        pcall(disc)
        local i = table.find(skinObs, entry)
        if i then table.remove(skinObs, i) end
    end
end)

local function handleEquip(slot, id)
    if type(slot) ~= "string" or not COSMETIC_SLOT[Inv.GetSlotType(slot)] then return false end
    if id == nil then
        if slotOverlay[slot] ~= nil then slotOverlay[slot] = nil save() fireAll() return true end
        return false
    end
    local fake = isCosmetic(id) and not orig.Owns(id)
    local locked = not orig.IsSlotAvailable(slot)
    if fake or locked then
        slotOverlay[slot] = id
        save() fireAll()
        return true
    end
    if slotOverlay[slot] ~= nil then slotOverlay[slot] = nil save() fireAll() end
    return false
end
local function handleSwap(a, b)
    if slotOverlay[a] == nil and slotOverlay[b] == nil then return false end
    local ea, eb = effective(a), effective(b)
    slotOverlay[a] = eb == nil and false or eb
    slotOverlay[b] = ea == nil and false or ea
    save() fireAll()
    return true
end
local function handleSkin(base, skin)
    if skin == nil then
        if skinOverlay[base] ~= nil then skinOverlay[base] = false save() fireAll() return true end
        return false
    end
    if isCosmetic(skin) and not orig.Owns(skin) then
        skinOverlay[base] = skin
        save() fireAll()
        return true
    end
    if skinOverlay[base] ~= nil then skinOverlay[base] = nil save() fireAll() end
    return false
end

local function setLocalEmote(id)
    local lc = CharacterService:GetLocalCharacter()
    if lc and lc.DataRegistry and origSetTerm then origSetTerm(lc.DataRegistry, "Emote", id) end
end
local function handleEmoteTask(kind, id)
    if kind ~= "Emote" then return false end
    if id == nil or id == 0 then
        if fakeEmote then fakeEmote = nil setLocalEmote(0) return true end
        return false
    end
    if type(id) == "number" and isCosmetic(id) and not orig.Owns(id) then
        fakeEmote = id
        setLocalEmote(id)
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local oldNamecall
oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
    if on() and getnamecallmethod() == "FireServer" then
        local handled = false
        if self == EquipRemote then handled = handleEquip(...)
        elseif self == SwapRemote then handled = handleSwap(...)
        elseif self == SetSkinRemote then handled = handleSkin(...)
        elseif self == TaskRemote then handled = handleEmoteTask(...) end
        if handled then blocked += 1 return end
    end
    return oldNamecall(self, ...)
end))

local WORN_SLOTS = {"CosmeticSlot_1", "CosmeticSlot_2", "UnusualSlot", "CharacterSlot"}
local OVERRIDE_TERMS = {"Cosmetics", "Nametag", "Emotes"}
local IS_OVERRIDDEN = {Cosmetics = true, Nametag = true, Emotes = true}
local serverVal = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})

local function hasWornOverlay()
    for _, s in ipairs(WORN_SLOTS) do
        if slotOverlay[s] ~= nil then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function wornList()
    local list = {}
    for _, s in ipairs(WORN_SLOTS) do
        local id = effective(s)
        if id then list[#list + 1] = id end
    end
    return list
end
local function hasEmoteOverlay()
    for i = 1, 12 do
        if slotOverlay["EmoteSlot_" .. i] ~= nil then return true end
    end
    return false
end
local function emoteList()
    local list = {}
    for i = 1, 12 do
        local id = effective("EmoteSlot_" .. i)
        if id then list[#list + 1] = {i, id} end
    end
    return list
end
local function desired(term, serverValue)
    if not on() then return serverValue end
    if term == "Cosmetics" and hasWornOverlay() then return wornList() end
    if term == "Emotes" and hasEmoteOverlay() then return emoteList() end
    if term == "Nametag" and slotOverlay.NametagSlot ~= nil then return effective("NametagSlot") end
    return serverValue
end
local function sameValue(a, b)
    if type(a) == "table" and type(b) == "table" then
        if #a ~= #b then return false end
        for i = 1, #a do if not sameValue(a[i], b[i]) then return false end end
        return true
    end
    return a == b
end

origSetTerm = hookfunction(CharRegistry.SetTerm, function(self, term, value)
    if term == "Emote" and fakeEmote and value ~= fakeEmote then
        local p = rawget(self, "Parent")
        if type(p) == "table" and p.Local then fakeEmote = nil end
    end
    if IS_OVERRIDDEN[term] then
        local p = rawget(self, "Parent")
        if type(p) == "table" and p.Local then
            local sv = serverVal[self]
            if not sv then sv = {seeded = true} serverVal[self] = sv end
            sv[term] = value
            value = desired(term, value)
        end
    end
    return origSetTerm(self, term, value)
end)

refreshLocal = function()
    for _, c in CharacterService:GetCharacters() do
        local reg = c.Local and c.DataRegistry
        if reg then
            local sv = serverVal[reg]
            if not sv then
                sv = {seeded = true, Cosmetics = reg.Data.Cosmetics, Nametag = reg.Data.Nametag, Emotes = reg.Data.Emotes}
                serverVal[reg] = sv
            end
            for _, term in ipairs(OVERRIDE_TERMS) do
                local want = desired(term, sv[term])
                if not sameValue(want, reg.Data[term]) then
                    origSetTerm(reg, term, want)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local running = true
task.spawn(function()
    while running do
        pcall(refreshLocal)
        task.wait(0.5)
    end
end)
pcall(refreshLocal)

getgenv().UnlockAllStop = function()
    getgenv().unlock_all_enabled = false
    table.clear(slotOverlay) table.clear(skinOverlay)
    pcall(fireAll)
    if fakeEmote then fakeEmote = nil pcall(setLocalEmote, 0) end
    running = false
    getgenv().UnlockAllStop = nil
end
getgenv().UnlockAllDebug = function() return {blocked = blocked, slots = slotOverlay, skins = skinOverlay, cosmetics = #allCosmetics} end

print("made by xyznick, enjoy!")

-- [[ SERVICES ]] --
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

---------------------------
-- CONFIG & GLOBALS
---------------------------
local ScriptEnabled = true
local AimbotEnabled = true
local AimbotRange = 1000
local PredictionFactor = 0.07
local MouseFOVRadius = 120
local AimSmoothness = 0.03
local TargetBlueOnly = false
local speedMultiplier = 0.001
local speedEnabled = false
local inputVector = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
local toggle = false
local blueNames = {}

-- FIX: activeTags was missing, causing the ESP crash!
local activeTags = {} 

_G.OutlineTransparency = 0.9
_G.FillTransparency = 1
local HoldingRMB = false
local Attacking = nil
local previousMouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.Default
local IsLocked = false
local LastTargetPosition = nil
local LastTargetVelocity = nil

-- OPTIMIZE: precomputed constants
local VEC_UP = Vector3.yAxis
local VEC_DOWN = -Vector3.yAxis

-- OPTIMIZE: cached services / references
local CharStats = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CharStats")
local charsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
local playerName = player.Name

-- OPTIMIZE: cache the PlayerGui
local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

---------------------------
-- UTILITY (OPTIMIZED)
---------------------------
local function isCharDisabledByName(name)
    local stats = CharStats
    if not stats then
        stats = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("CharStats")
        CharStats = stats
        if not stats then return false end
    end
    local pstats = stats:FindFirstChild(name)
    if not pstats then return false end
    local d = pstats:FindFirstChild("Downed")
    if d and d.Value then return true end
    local g = pstats:FindFirstChild("Grabbed")
    if g and g.Value then return true end
    local rt = pstats:FindFirstChild("RagdollTime")
    local rs = rt and rt:FindFirstChild("RagdollSwitch")
    if rs and rs.Value then return true end
    return false
end

local function isCharacterDisabled()
    return isCharDisabledByName(playerName)
end

---------------------------
-- FULLBRIGHT (OPTIMIZED)
---------------------------
local fbEnabled = false
local fbConnection = nil
local lightingBackup = {children = {}, props = {}}

local function applyFullBright()
    lightingBackup.props = {
        Ambient = Lighting.Ambient,
        OutdoorAmbient = Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        Brightness = Lighting.Brightness,
        ClockTime = Lighting.ClockTime,
        FogEnd = Lighting.FogEnd,
        GlobalShadows = Lighting.GlobalShadows,
        ExposureCompensation = Lighting.ExposureCompensation,
        EnvironmentDiffuseScale = Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale,
        EnvironmentSpecularScale = Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale,
        GeographicLatitude = Lighting.GeographicLatitude,
    }
    for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("Sky") or child:IsA("Clouds") then
            lightingBackup.children[#lightingBackup.children + 1] = child
            child.Parent = nil
        end
    end
    Lighting.Brightness = 3
    Lighting.ClockTime = 12
    Lighting.GeographicLatitude = 41.7
    Lighting.FogEnd = 1e5
    Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
    Lighting.ExposureCompensation = 0.5
    Lighting.Ambient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 1
    Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0
    fbConnection = Lighting.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
        if child:IsA("PostEffect") or child:IsA("Atmosphere") or child:IsA("Sky") then
            task.defer(function() if fbEnabled then child.Parent = nil end end)
        end
    end)
end

local function restoreLighting()
    for prop, val in pairs(lightingBackup.props) do Lighting[prop] = val end
    for _, child in ipairs(lightingBackup.children) do
        if child and child.Parent == nil then child.Parent = Lighting end
    end
    lightingBackup.children = {}
end

local function toggleFullBright()
    fbEnabled = not fbEnabled
    if fbEnabled then
        applyFullBright()
    else
        if fbConnection then fbConnection:Disconnect() fbConnection = nil end
        restoreLighting()
    end
end

---------------------------
-- MONEY ESP (OPTIMIZED)
---------------------------
local moneyActive = false
local moneyTags = {} -- [obj] = billboard
local moneyContainer = Workspace:WaitForChild("Map"):WaitForChild("BredMakurz")

local function updateMoneyTag(obj)
    local values = obj:FindFirstChild("Values")
    local broken = values and values:FindFirstChild("Broken")

    if not moneyActive or (broken and broken.Value) then
        local t = moneyTags[obj]
        if t then t:Destroy() moneyTags[obj] = nil end
        return
    end

    if not moneyTags[obj] then
        local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        bb.Name = "MoneyTag"
        bb.Adornee = obj
        bb.Size = UDim2.new(0, 60, 0, 30)
        bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0)
        bb.AlwaysOnTop = true
        local tl = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        tl.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        tl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        tl.Text = "MONEY"
        tl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100)
        tl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        tl.TextScaled = true
        tl.Parent = bb
        bb.Parent = obj
        moneyTags[obj] = bb
        if broken then
            broken:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(function()
                if broken.Value then updateMoneyTag(obj) end
            end)
        end
    end
end

local function clearMoneyTags()
    for _, tag in pairs(moneyTags) do tag:Destroy() end
    moneyTags = {}
end

---------------------------
-- UI FRAMEWORK
---------------------------
local Theme = {
    Main = Color3.fromRGB(15, 18, 26),
    Header = Color3.fromRGB(25, 30, 45),
    Accent = Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 255),
    Text = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 230),
    Button = Color3.fromRGB(30, 35, 50),
    On = Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 120),
    Off = Color3.fromRGB(220, 60, 60),
}

local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "MidnightCheatUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.IgnoreGuiInset = true

    if not speedEnabled then return end
    local char = player.Character
    if not char then return end
    local humanoid = char.Humanoid

        end
        return
    end
    local moveDir = humanoid.MoveDirection
    if moveDir.X ~= 0 or moveDir.Z ~= 0 then
        rootPart.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame + (moveDir.Unit * humanoid.WalkSpeed * speedMultiplier * dt)
    end
end)

local losParams = RaycastParams.new()
losParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
losParams.IgnoreWater = true

local function HasLineOfSight(targetChar)
    local head = targetChar.Head
    if not head then return false end
    local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    local localChar = player.Character
    if not cam or not localChar then return false end
    losParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {localChar, cam, targetChar}
    local origin = cam.CFrame.Position
    local dir = head.Position - origin
    local ray = Workspace:Raycast(origin, dir, losParams)
    return ray == nil or ray.Instance:IsDescendantOf(targetChar)
end

---------------------------
-- AIMBOT (OPTIMIZED)
---------------------------
local AIM_USE_LOS = true
local AIM_DEBUG = false
local AIM_THROTTLE = 3
local frameCounter = 0

-- OPTIMIZE: reusable table to reduce GC pressure
local candidateBuffer = {}

RunService:BindToRenderStep("SerenityAimbot", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, function()
    if not AimbotEnabled or not HoldingRMB then
        if Attacking then Attacking = nil IsLocked = false end
        return
    end

    Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
    if not Camera then return end

    if isCharacterDisabled() then
        Attacking = nil
        IsLocked = false
        return
    end

    frameCounter = frameCounter + 1
    local doSearch = (frameCounter % AIM_THROTTLE) == 0

    if not charsFolder or not charsFolder.Parent then
        charsFolder = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")
    end

    local localChar = player.Character
    local localHrp = localChar and localChar.HumanoidRootPart
    local mousePos = UIS:GetMouseLocation()

    -- Validate current lock
    if Attacking then
        local c = Attacking.char
        if not c or not c.Parent then
            Attacking = nil
            IsLocked = false
        else
            local head = c:FindFirstChild("Head")
            local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local dist = (hrp and localHrp) and (hrp.Position - localHrp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            local dead = hum and hum.Health <= 0
            local disabled = Attacking.plr and isCharDisabledByName(Attacking.plr.Name)

            if not head or dead or disabled or dist > AimbotRange then
                Attacking = nil
                IsLocked = false
            else
                LastTargetPosition = head.Position
                LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity
            end
        end
    end

    -- Search (throttled)
    if not Attacking and doSearch then
        local bestTarget = nil
        local bufIndex = 0
        
        local function consider(char, plr)
            if not char or not char.Parent then return end
            if plr == player then return end
            local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if not head then return end
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health <= 0 then return end
            if plr then
                if isCharDisabledByName(plr.Name) then return end
                if TargetBlueOnly and not blueNames[plr.Name] then return end
            end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local dist = (hrp and localHrp) and (hrp.Position - localHrp.Position).Magnitude or math.huge
            if dist > AimbotRange then return end

            local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(head.Position)
            if not onScreen then return end
            local dx = screenPos.X - mousePos.X
            local dy = screenPos.Y - mousePos.Y
            local d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy
            local fov2 = MouseFOVRadius * MouseFOVRadius
            if d2 > fov2 then return end

            bufIndex = bufIndex + 1
            candidateBuffer[bufIndex] = {char = char, plr = plr, d2 = d2}
        end

        for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            consider(plr.Character, plr)
        end

        if charsFolder then
            for _, obj in ipairs(charsFolder:GetChildren()) do
                local rig
                if obj:IsA("Model") then
                    rig = obj
                elseif obj:IsA("Folder") then
                    rig = obj:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Model")
                end
                if rig then
                    local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(rig) or Players:FindFirstChild(obj.Name)
                    consider(rig, plr)
                end
            end
        end

        -- clear trailing buffer entries
        for i = bufIndex + 1, #candidateBuffer do
            candidateBuffer[i] = nil
        end

        if bufIndex > 0 then
            -- sort by 2D squared distance
            table.sort(candidateBuffer, function(a, b) return a.d2 < b.d2 end)

            -- OPTIMIZE: only LOS-check top 4 candidates (usually enough)
            local maxCheck = math.min(bufIndex, 4)
            for i = 1, maxCheck do
                local cand = candidateBuffer[i]
                if (not AIM_USE_LOS) or HasLineOfSight(cand.char) then
                    bestTarget = cand
                    break
                end
            end

            -- cleanup
            for i = 1, bufIndex do candidateBuffer[i] = nil end
        end

        if bestTarget then
            Attacking = {char = bestTarget.char, plr = bestTarget.plr}
            IsLocked = true
            local head = bestTarget.char:FindFirstChild("Head")
            if head then
                LastTargetPosition = head.Position
                LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity
            end
        end
    end

    -- Aim
    if Attacking and IsLocked then
        local tChar = Attacking.char
        if not tChar or not tChar.Parent then return end
        local head = tChar:FindFirstChild("Head")
        if not head then return end

        LastTargetPosition = head.Position
        LastTargetVelocity = head.Velocity

        local pred = head.Position + (head.Velocity * PredictionFactor)
        local smoothFactor = 1 / (AimSmoothness * 60)
        if smoothFactor < 0.01 then smoothFactor = 0.01
        elseif smoothFactor > 1 then smoothFactor = 1 end

        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, pred), smoothFactor)
    end
end)

    local cachedFramesFolder = nil

            cachedSelections = nil
            cachedScales = nil

            local lpgui = cachedLPGui

                lpgui = playerGui:FindFirstChild("LockpickGUI")
                cachedLPGui = lpgui
                cachedFramesFolder = nil
                cachedSelections = nil
                cachedScales = nil
            end

            if lpgui and lpgui.Enabled then
                if not cachedFramesFolder or not cachedFramesFolder.Parent then
                    local mf = lpgui:FindFirstChild("MF")
                    local lpFrame = mf and mf:FindFirstChild("LP_Frame")
                    cachedFramesFolder = lpFrame and lpFrame:FindFirstChild("Frames")

	c.Parent = btn

end

local buildBtn = makeButton("BuildButton", 15, 136, 270, "BUILD TEXT", Color3.fromRGB(0, 140, 80))
local undoBtn = makeButton("UndoButton", 15, 180, 130, "UNDO", Color3.fromRGB(180, 130, 0))

status.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 220)

status.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 180)
status.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
status.TextSize = 13
status.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
status.Parent = frame

local function getRoot()
	local character = player.Character
	return character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function buildText()
	local root = getRoot()
	if not root then
		status.Text = "No character found"
		return
	end

	local text = string.upper(textInput.Text)
	if #text == 0 then
		status.Text = "Enter some text first"
		return
	end

	local size = math.clamp(tonumber(sizeInput.Text) or 1, 0.2, 10)
	local look = root.CFrame.LookVector
	local origin = root.Position + look * 12 + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
	local base = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + look)

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TextBlocks_" .. text
	local blockCount = 0
	local totalCols = #text * 6 - 1
	local startX = -((totalCols - 1) / 2) * size

	for i = 1, #text do
		local ch = string.sub(text, i, i)
		local glyph = glyphs[ch]
		if glyph then
			local colOffset = (i - 1) * 6
			local hue = (i - 1) / math.max(#text, 1)
			local color = Color3.fromHSV(hue, 0.6, 1)
			for row = 1, 7 do
				local line = glyph[row]
				for col = 1, 5 do
					if string.sub(line, col, col) == "#" then
						local x = startX + (colOffset + col - 1) * size
						local y = (7 - row) * size
						local part = Instance.new("Part")
						part.Size = Vector3.new(size, size, size)
						part.Anchored = true
						part.CanCollide = true
						part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
						part.Color = color
						part.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
						part.CFrame = base * CFrame.new(x, y, 0)
						part.Parent = model
						blockCount += 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if blockCount == 0 then
		model:Destroy()
		status.Text = "No supported characters (A-Z, 0-9)"
		return
	end

	model.Parent = workspace
	table.insert(builtModels, model)
	status.Text = "Built " .. blockCount .. " blocks"
end

buildBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(buildText)

undoBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	local last = table.remove(builtModels)
	if last then
		last:Destroy()
		status.Text = "Undid last build"
	else
		status.Text = "Nothing to undo"
	end
end)

clearBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	for _, model in ipairs(builtModels) do
		model:Destroy()
	end
	table.clear(builtModels)
	status.Text = "Cleared all text"
end)

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local function notify(text, duration)
	local notif = Instance.new("Frame")
	notif.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
	notif.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 34, 36)
	notif.BorderSizePixel = 0
	notif.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	notif.ClipsDescendants = true
	notif.Parent = notifications
	
	local nCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	nCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
	nCorner.Parent = notif
	
	local nStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
	nStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(85, 90, 95)
	nStroke.Thickness = 1
	nStroke.Transparency = 1
	nStroke.Parent = notif
	
	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
	label.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.Text = text
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 205, 210)
	label.TextSize = 11
	label.Font = Enum.Font.Code
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.TextWrapped = true
	label.TextTransparency = 1
	label.Parent = notif
	
	local textBounds = label.TextBounds.Y + 12
	
	TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, textBounds),
		BackgroundTransparency = 0
	}):Play()
	
	TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 0}):Play()
	TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 0}):Play()
	
	task.delay(duration or 3, function()
		TweenService:Create(notif, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1
		}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(label, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
		TweenService:Create(nStroke, TweenInfo.new(0.25), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
		task.wait(0.25)
		notif:Destroy()
	end)
end

local visible = false
local animating = false

local function toggleGui()
	if animating then return end
	animating = true
	visible = not visible
	
	local targetPos = visible and UDim2.new(1, -290, 0.5, -190) or UDim2.new(1, 300, 0.5, -190)
	
	TweenService:Create(main, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
		Position = targetPos
	}):Play()
	
	task.wait(0.35)
	animating = false
end

hideBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleGui)

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe then return end
	if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.P then
		toggleGui()
	end
end)

local processed = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then return end
	
	for sound, original in pairs(originalSounds) do
		if sound and sound.Parent then
			sound.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
		end
	end
end)

local function applyForceField(plr, character)
	if plr.Name ~= getgenv().StretchConfig.ForceFieldUser then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField
			obj.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("White")
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr)
	plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
		task.spawn(applyForceField, plr, char)
	end)
end)

if player.Character then
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, player.Character)
end

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
	task.spawn(applyForceField, player, char)
end)

local holding = false

UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
	if gpe or not getgenv().StretchConfig.AutoSprint then return end
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(true, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = true
	end
end)

UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
	if input.KeyCode == getgenv().StretchConfig.SprintKey and holding then
		VM:SendKeyEvent(false, getgenv().StretchConfig.HoldKey, false, game)
		holding = false
	end
end)

local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
	if not getgenv().StretchConfig.StretchEnabled then return end
	
	local cfg = getgenv().StretchConfig
	Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(
		0, 0, 0,
		1, 0, 0,
		0, cfg.Scale, 0,
		0, 0, 1
	)
end)

task.spawn(optimizeGame)
notify("Screen Stretch • Press P", 3)

local function fireproximityprompt(Obj, Amount, Skip)
    if Obj.ClassName == "ProximityPrompt" then 
        Amount = Amount or 1
        local PromptTime = Obj.HoldDuration
        if Skip then 
            Obj.HoldDuration = 0
        end
        for i = 1, Amount do 
            Obj:InputHoldBegin()
            if not Skip then 
                wait(Obj.HoldDuration)
            end
            Obj:InputHoldEnd()
        end
        Obj.HoldDuration = PromptTime
    else 
        error("userdata<ProximityPrompt> expected")
    end
end

-- Função para gerar uma cor aleatória com valores mais altos
local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo
while true do
    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end

Section3:Button({
   Text = "Aim",
   Callback = function()
-- Credit Dollynho --

local fov = 36
local maxDistance = 350
local maxTransparency = 0.1
local teamCheck = false
local wallCheck = true
local aimPart = "Head"  -- "Torso"

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end
})

local function formatNumber(n)
    local formatted = tostring(n)
    local k
    while true do
        formatted, k = string.gsub(formatted, "^(-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", '%1,%2')
        if k == 0 then break end
    end
    return formatted
end

local function moveToTarget()
    if humanoidRootPart then
        humanoidRootPart.CFrame = targetPosition
    end
end

local cashRegisters = {}

local safes = {}

local function updateCaches()
    for _, child in ipairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Model") then
            if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
                table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
            elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
                table.insert(safes, child)
            end
        end
    end
end

updateCaches()

Workspace.ChildAdded:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            table.insert(cashRegisters, child)
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            table.insert(safes, child)
        end
    end
end)

Workspace.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(child)
    if child:IsA("Model") then
        if child.Name == "CashRegister" then
            for i = #cashRegisters, 1, -1 do
                if cashRegisters[i] == child then
                    table.remove(cashRegisters, i)
                end
            end
        elseif child.Name == "Safe" then
            for i = #safes, 1, -1 do
                if safes[i] == child then
                    table.remove(safes, i)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end)

local function checkCashRegister()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #cashRegisters do
        local item = cashRegisters[i]
        local openPart = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
        if openPart then
            humanoidRootPart.CFrame = openPart.CFrame
            robEvent:FireServer("Register", {
                Part = item:FindFirstChild("Union"),
                OpenPart = openPart,
                ActiveValue = item:FindFirstChild("Active"),
                Active = true
            })
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function checkSafe()
    if bag.Value >= bagSizeLevel.Value then
        moveToTarget()
        return false
    end
    for i = 1, #safes do
        local item = safes[i]
        if item:FindFirstChild("Amount") and item.Amount.Value > 0 then
            local safePart = item:FindFirstChild("Safe")
            if safePart then
                humanoidRootPart.CFrame = safePart.CFrame
                local openFlag = item:FindFirstChild("Open")
                if openFlag and openFlag.Value then
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                else
                    local openSafe = item:FindFirstChild("OpenSafe")
                    if openSafe then
                        openSafe:FireServer("Completed")
                    end
                    robEvent:FireServer("Safe", item)
                end
                return true
            end
        end
    end
    return false
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if not checkCashRegister() then
        checkSafe()
    end
end)

    end
end)

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)
 local a = 0
 for i, v in pairs(tbl) do
  a = a + 1
 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

function Queue.new()
    local self = setmetatable({}, Queue)
    self.elements = {}
    return self
end

function Queue:Queue(element)
    table.insert(self.elements, element)
end

function Queue:Update()
    if #self.elements == 0 then
        return nil
    end
    return table.remove(self.elements, 1)
end

function Queue:IsEmpty()
    return #self.elements == 0
end
function Queue:Current()
    return self.elements
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)
    local letters = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    return ((data:gsub('.', function(x) 
        local r,b='',x:byte()
        for i=8,1,-1 do r=r..(b%2^i-b%2^(i-1)>0 and '1' or '0') end
        return r;
    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])
end
funcs.base64.decode = function(data)
    local b = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
    data = string.gsub(data, '[^'..b..'=]', '')
    return (data:gsub('.', function(x)
        if x == '=' then return '' end
        local r, f = '', (b:find(x) - 1)
        for i = 6, 1, -1 do
            r = r .. (f % 2^i - f % 2^(i - 1) > 0 and '1' or '0')
        end
        return r;
    end):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if #x ~= 8 then return '' end
        local c = 0
        for i = 1, 8 do
            c = c + (x:sub(i, i) == '1' and 2^(8 - i) or 0)
        end
        return string.char(c)
    end))
end

    hex = tostring(hex)

        local byte = tonumber(byte_str, 16)
        text = text .. string.char(byte)

funcs.crypt.generatekey = function(optionalSize)
 local key = ''
 local a = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/'
 for i = 1, optionalSize or 32 do local n = math.random(1, #a) key = key .. a:sub(n, n) end
 return funcs.base64.encode(key)
end

funcs.crypt.encrypt = function(a, b)
 local result = {}
 a = tostring(a) b = tostring(b)
 for i = 1, #a do
    local byte = string.byte(a, i)
    local keyByte = string.byte(b, (i - 1) % #b + 1)
    table.insert(result, string.char(bit32.bxor(byte, keyByte)))
 end
 return table.concat(result)
end

  local b = {coroutine.yield()}
  while true do
   b = {coroutine.yield(f(table.unpack(b)))}
  end
 end)

funcs.isexecutorclosure = function(fnc)
    local found = false
    for i, v in pairs(getgenv()) do
     if v == fnc then return true end
    end
    for i = 1, math.huge do
        local s, env = pcall(getfenv, i)
        if not s or found then break end
        if type(env) == "table" then
            for _, v in pairs(env) do
                if v == fnc then
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
        end
        if found then break end
    end

    return found
end

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')
 local CurrentPath = {}
 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]
  elseif i == #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
 end
end

 local s, func = pcall(function()
  return loadstring(content)

funcs.listfiles = function(path)
    if not path or path == '' then
     local Files = {}
     for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if #i:split('/') == 1 then table.insert(Files, i) end
     end
     return Files
    end
    if type(files[path]) ~= 'table' then return error(path .. ' is not a folder.') end
    local Files = {}
    for i, v in pairs(files) do
      if startswith(i, path .. '/') and not endswith(i, '/') and i ~= path and #i:split('/') == (#path:split('/') + 1) then table.insert(Files, i) end
    end
    return Files
end

funcs.Drawing.new = function(Type) -- Drawing.new
    local baseProps = {
     Visible = false,
     Color = Color3.new(0,0,0),
     ClassName = nil
    }
    if Type == 'Line' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", Instance.new("ScreenGui", DrawingDict))
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Thickness = 1,
            From = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            To = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Transparency = 0,
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateLine = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             local from = self.From
             local to = self.To
             local distance = (to - from).Magnitude
             local angle = math.deg(math.atan2(to.Y - from.Y, to.X - from.X))

             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, distance, 0, self.Thickness)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, from.X, 0, from.Y)
             a.Rotation = angle
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Thickness' and typeof(value) == 'number' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Size = UDim2.new(0, (self.To - self.From).Magnitude, 0, value)
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
            elseif key == 'Transparency' and typeof(value) == 'number' and value <= 1 then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - value
            elseif key == 'From' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            elseif key == 'To' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateLine()
            end
        end
        local meta1 = setmetatable({}, meta)
        Drawings[meta1] = meta1
        return meta1
    elseif Type == 'Square' then
        local a = Instance.new("Frame", DrawingDict)
        a.Visible = false
        a.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
        a.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        a.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        a.BorderSizePixel = 0
        local b = Instance.new("UIStroke", a)
        b.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        b.Enabled = true

        local meta = baseProps
        meta.ClassName = Type
        meta.__index = {
            Size = Vector2.new(0,0),
            Position = Vector2.new(0, 0),
            Remove = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            Destroy = function()
               for i, v in pairs(Drawings) do if v == meta then Drawings[i] = nil end end
               a:Destroy() 
            end,
            updateSquare = function(self)
             if not a then return end
             a.Size = UDim2.new(0, self.Size.X, 0, self.Size.Y)
             a.Position = UDim2.new(0, self.Position.X, 0, self.Position.Y)
            end
        }

        meta.__newindex = function(self, key, value)
            if not self then return end
            if key == 'Filled' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                b.Enabled = not value
                a.BackgroundTransparency = value and 0 or 1
            elseif key == 'Visible' and typeof(value) == 'boolean' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.Visible = value
            elseif key == 'Color' and typeof(value) == 'Color3' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                a.BackgroundColor3 = value
                b.Color = value
            elseif key == 'Position' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
                self:updateSquare()
            elseif key == 'Size' and typeof(value) == 'Vector2' then
                rawset(self, key, value)
